Starting θ0=1/3: s0=a gives s1=b, and s0=b gives s1=b,s2=a, all at exact branch conditions. Since each s is nonunit the iterates never terminate early and x^{k+2}=(1-a)(1-b)x^k with absolute factor <1. Interior strict branch inequalities make T²(p,q)=(C(q),q) locally, derivative eigenvalues 0,1. Independent symbolic reciprocals and 99 ratio samples checked 15,840 scalar recurrence values; the proof of the continuum is analytic.
